design_notes.T_spinup: Candidate selected for formal runs; verify with sampling_check_server.json before interpretation.
design_notes.n_seed: 46 independent initial-condition seeds; task parallelism is by seed.
design_notes.solver: Candidate DOP853 tolerances; sampling-check recommendations are advisory and never auto-applied.

sampling_rationale.fft_length: 2^16 sets the reported FFT frequency grid to 32/65536 = 0.00048828125.
sampling_rationale.n_record_samples: 2^18 post-spinup samples provide an 8192-time-unit record at sample_rate=32.
sampling_rationale.n_seed: 96 independent initial-condition seeds give the peak/background t tests materially smaller seed uncertainty than the shared 46-seed base config.
sampling_rationale.welch_segment_length: 2^15 gives long local spectra while retaining 15 overlapping Welch segments per seed.
